answer: Unrepeatable Response Commitment. Each agent identity registers a fresh nonce; every answer must embed that nonce plus a committed hash of the query, so copies fail verification. On a small knoll of shared challenge data, the verifier checks the nonce never repeats across identities. An attacker cloning one answer pays a distinct registration cost per nonce, and any echo of an existing response is rejected. Sybil cost scales linearly with fake identities, since each needs a unique validated pearl of query-bound randomness.
